name: Northern Natural Gas Peak Day 2000 Expansion I
researcher_notes: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 50: NNG Peak Day 2000 Expansion I, operator Northern Natural Gas Co, type Expansion, status Completed, in service November 1997, states KS, NE, IA, MN, WI, cost 102 million dollars, 39 miles, 244 MMcf/d additional capacity, FERC docket CP97-27, interstate. url_verifier passed with the project name. This is one source, from one release. No existing GEM row covers it: the roster has the main line (P2579) and later Northern Lights expansions, none for Peak Day 2000. 39 miles is about 63 km, above the 25 km threshold, so it is a new expansion row under the parent name. Open conflicts: a web search summary says the program was FERC docket CP97-25, approved June 1997, 32 miles and 267 MMcf/d. That did not come from a page we could read, so it is not used. A second independent source, such as the FERC order or the 1997 Federal Register notice, was not found. The FERC approved major projects page loaded but did not show this project. Two Federal Register issues from 1997 were opened and did not mention Northern Natural. EIA also lists Peak Day 2000 Expansion II (5 miles, 1998) and later phases, which are under 25 km and not staged. Start and end locations are not stated by EIA beyond the five states, so they are left blank. No route found, so no route is staged. Owner spelled as on the sibling Northern Natural rows; Parent as on P2579. Confidence high on existence, medium on exact length and capacity given the single source.
